content.value: The Passive Skill Tree is the primary progression system in Cranks Dungeons. It's a sprawling network of interconnected nodes that grant permanent stat bonuses to your character.
You earn passive skill points by gaining standard Minecraft experience levels. Each level-up awards one unspent point that you can allocate on the tree.

To allocate a node, it must be connected to a node you've already unlocked. Click on an available node to draft it (preview), then click 'Apply Changes' to commit your selections. You can draft multiple nodes at once before applying.
Drafted nodes are shown in a different color. You can click a drafted node again to un-draft it (remove it from your preview). Only applied nodes are permanent.

• Small Nodes (Square) — Minor stat bonuses like +5 Strength or +2% Fire Resistance.
• Notable Nodes (Circle) — Larger bonuses that define your build, like +15% Attack Speed or +30 Max Health.
• Keystone Nodes (Diamond) — Powerful build-defining effects with significant trade-offs.
• Choice Nodes (Hexagon) — Let you choose which attribute to scale (STR, DEX, or INT).

• Press P to open the Passive Tree directly.
• Press O to switch to the World Tree.
• Press C to open the Compendium.
• Use the mouse wheel to zoom in/out.
• Click and drag to pan around the tree.
